canonical_example.translation: Stay still and don't say a word.

canonical_example.translation: Can't you be still for just a minute?

canonical_example.translation: Who but she could have planned such a fun party?

canonical_example.text: A mi perrito le encanta todo el mundo sino mi exesposa.
canonical_example.translation: My puppy loves everyone except my ex-wife.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermano come de todo sino marisco.
canonical_example.translation: My brother eats everything save seafood.

canonical_example.text: Su sino es viajar de país en país.
canonical_example.translation: His fate is to travel from one country to another.

canonical_example.text: ¿Ponemos algo de música?
canonical_example.translation: Shall we put some music on?

canonical_example.translation: A pianist and other talented musicians played at the concert.

canonical_example.text: ¿Tocas algún instrumento músico?
canonical_example.translation: Do you play a musical instrument?

canonical_example.text: Un verdadero caballero es respetuoso con todos.
canonical_example.translation: A true gentleman is respectful to everyone.

canonical_example.text: El rey le otorgó tierras y riquezas al caballero.
canonical_example.translation: The king bestowed lands and wealth on the knight.

canonical_example.text: Su habitación está lista, caballero.
canonical_example.translation: Your room is ready, sir.

canonical_example.text: El joven caballero le ayudó a la mujer de edad avanzada a cruzar la calle.
canonical_example.translation: The gentlemanly young man helped the elderly woman cross the street.

canonical_example.text: Puedes usar mi teléfono viejo si no logras encontrar el tuyo.
canonical_example.translation: You can use my old phone if you don't manage to find yours.

canonical_example.text: Voy a usar mi chaqueta nueva cuando haga frío.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to wear my new jacket when it gets cold.

canonical_example.text: En verano se vuelven a usar los vestidos y las faldas.
canonical_example.translation: In summer, dresses and skirts are worn again.

canonical_example.text: Se usaban los overoles en los ochenta y los noventa.
canonical_example.translation: Overalls were in fashion in the eighties and nineties.

canonical_example.text: Así no se hacen las cosas acá.
canonical_example.translation: That's not how we do things here.
